name: ottomation
description: ottomation: Paul Otto's Claude Code plugins. Currently live-vibe (full-duplex voice and director mode) and diagram-pane (a side pane of live diagrams).

plugins.name: live-vibe
plugins.description: /live: full-duplex voice (Kyutai streaming STT with semantic end of turn, or Silero and Whisper; Kokoro TTS) through a sidecar; /vibe: director mode that delegates all work to subagents; /livevibe: talk with a fast voice front that hands the work to Claude as director.

plugins.name: diagram-pane
plugins.description: A side pane that pins every diagram Claude draws, keeps a live map of the work, and lets you go into boxes and change them. Vendored from Ray Amjad's claude-code-mods (MIT) with navigation and editing added.
